title: Guard Personal Data
description: Hands-on: mask the personal data in support messages before an LLM summarizes them: regular expressions with a Luhn check, NER Extractor with a RegexNER rule file, typed placeholders with the mapping kept apart, a check that quarantines what slipped through, a run instruction and output validation against prompt injection, re-identification inside the trusted zone, and an audit of what was masked.
